visual_review.assessment: Six complete volcanic giant poses preserve two massive fists, molten fissures and spiked boulder plates. Knee/foot loading changes are visible, but near leg dominates all contacts and the six phases do not establish an unambiguous alternating gait. One bounded correction did not fix the core issue; original kept.
